title: Molecular design of high-performance wide-bandgap acceptor enables versatile organic photovoltaic applications
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05022C, Paper
Yang Xiao, Jingwen Wang, Yong Cui, Yafei Wang, Zhihao Chen, Shuohan Cheng, Haoyu Yuan, Jiawei Qiao, Yi Yang, Wenxuan Wang, Ni Yang, Yue Yu, Runnan Yu, Xiaotao Hao, Jianhui Hou
A low-cost wide-bandgap acceptor FPCC-Br was designed which exhibited a champion PCE of 13.6% in OPV cells below 720 nm and demonstrated significant advantages in indoor lighting, tandem cells, and underwater photovoltaic electrolysis applications.
